channel.title: AllCoaching Blog — Essays on the Future of Online Education in India
channel.description: Long-form, founder-written essays on educator infrastructure, marketplace economics, AI workflows, EdTech compliance, and the architecture of online teaching in India. By Amit Ratan, Founder & CEO of AllCoaching — India's first educator-first marketplace, founded 2018 in Prayagraj.

item.title: Best AI Tools for Teachers in India (2026) — and Where to Actually Use Them
item.description: The best AI tools for teachers in India in 2026 — by job: lesson plans, notes, slides, quizzes and mock tests, video and voice, doubt-solving and marketing. Plus the part most lists skip: AI creates content fast, but a folder of AI-made material earns nothing. Here is how to turn it into income on the AllCoaching edtech marketplace.
item.dc:creator: Amit Ratan
